verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֖א שֵׁ֣מַע שָׁ֑וְא אַל־ תָּ֤שֶׁת יָֽדְךָ֙ עִם־ רָשָׁ֔ע לִהְיֹ֖ת עֵ֥ד חָמָֽס׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯiś·śā šê·ma‘ šāw ’al- tā·šeṯ yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘im- rā·šā‘ lih·yōṯ ‘êḏ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: You shall not spread a false report Do not join . . . . . . the wicked by being a malicious witness

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרֵֽי־ רַבִּ֖ים לְרָעֹ֑ת וְלֹא־ תַעֲנֶ֣ה עַל־ רִ֗ב לִנְטֹ֛ת אַחֲרֵ֥י רַבִּ֖ים לְהַטֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯih·yeh ’a·ḥă·rê- rab·bîm lə·rā·‘ōṯ wə·lō- ṯa·‘ă·neh ‘al- riḇ lin·ṭōṯ ’a·ḥă·rê rab·bîm lə·haṭ·ṭōṯ
verses.literal: You shall not follow . . . the crowd in wrongdoing When you testify in a lawsuit do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd

verses.original: וְדָ֕ל לֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר בְּרִיבֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏāl lō ṯeh·dar bə·rî·ḇōw
verses.literal: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִפְגַּ֞ע שׁ֧וֹר אֹֽיִבְךָ֛ א֥וֹ חֲמֹר֖וֹ תֹּעֶ֑ה הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֶ֖נּוּ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ṯip̄·ga‘ šō·wr ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā ’ōw ḥă·mō·rōw tō·‘eh hā·šêḇ tə·šî·ḇen·nū lōw
verses.literal: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey you must return it . . . to him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ֗ רֹבֵץ֙ תַּ֣חַת מַשָּׂא֔וֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ֖ מֵעֲזֹ֣ב ל֑וֹ עָזֹ֥ב תַּעֲזֹ֖ב עִמּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯir·’eh ḥă·mō·wr śō·na·’ă·ḵā rō·ḇêṣ ta·ḥaṯ maś·śā·’ōw wə·ḥā·ḏal·tā mê·‘ă·zōḇ lōw ‘ā·zōḇ ta·‘ă·zōḇ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load do not leave it there you must help him . . . with it

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיֹנְךָ֖ בְּרִיבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaṭ·ṭeh miš·paṭ ’eḇ·yō·nə·ḵā bə·rî·ḇōw
verses.literal: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits

verses.original: מִדְּבַר־ שֶׁ֖קֶר תִּרְחָ֑ק וְנָקִ֤י וְצַדִּיק֙ אַֽל־ תַּהֲרֹ֔ג כִּ֥י לֹא־ אַצְדִּ֖יק רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: mid·də·ḇar- še·qer tir·ḥāq wə·nā·qî wə·ṣad·dîq ’al- ta·hă·rōḡ kî lō- ’aṣ·dîq rā·šā‘
verses.literal: Stay far away from a false accusation Do not kill the innocent or the just for I will not acquit the guilty

verses.original: וְשֹׁ֖חַד לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח כִּ֤י הַשֹּׁ֙חַד֙ יְעַוֵּ֣ר פִּקְחִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·ḥaḏ lō ṯiq·qāḥ kî haš·šō·ḥaḏ yə·‘aw·wêr piq·ḥîm wî·sal·lêp̄ diḇ·rê ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: Do not accept a bribe for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous

verses.original: וְגֵ֖ר לֹ֣א תִלְחָ֑ץ וְאַתֶּ֗ם יְדַעְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַגֵּ֔ר כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡêr lō ṯil·ḥāṣ wə·’at·tem yə·ḏa‘·tem ’eṯ- ne·p̄eš hag·gêr kî- ḡê·rîm hĕ·yî·ṯem bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Do not oppress a foreign resident since you yourselves know - how it feels to be foreigners for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת־ אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêš šā·nîm tiz·ra‘ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣe·ḵā wə·’ā·sap̄·tā ’eṯ- tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁבִיעִ֞ת תִּשְׁמְטֶ֣נָּה וּנְטַשְׁתָּ֗הּ וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ אֶבְיֹנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְיִתְרָ֕ם תֹּאכַ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה כֵּֽן־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְכַרְמְךָ֖ לְזֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šə·ḇî·‘iṯ tiš·mə·ṭen·nāh ū·nə·ṭaš·tāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eḇ·yō·nê ‘am·me·ḵā wə·yiṯ·rām tō·ḵal ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh kên- ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵar·mə·ḵā lə·zê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת לְמַ֣עַן יָנ֗וּחַ שֽׁוֹרְךָ֙ וַחֲמֹרֶ֔ךָ וְיִנָּפֵ֥שׁ בֶּן־ אֲמָתְךָ֖ וְהַגֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·śeh ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î tiš·bōṯ lə·ma·‘an yā·nū·aḥ šō·wr·ḵā wa·ḥă·mō·re·ḵā wə·yin·nā·p̄êš ben- ’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā wə·hag·gêr
verses.literal: For six days you are to do your work but on the seventh day you must cease so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed as well as the foreign resident

verses.original: וּבְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁמֵ֑רוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לֹ֣א תַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עַל־ פִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·mar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem tiš·šā·mê·rū wə·šêm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lō ṯaz·kî·rū lō yiš·šā·ma‘ ‘al- pî·ḵā
verses.literal: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you You must not invoke the names of other gods they must not be heard on your lips

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֔ים תָּחֹ֥ג לִ֖י בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lōš rə·ḡā·lîm tā·ḥōḡ lî baš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me

verses.original: אֶת־ חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִים֩ תֹּאכַ֨ל מַצּ֜וֹת כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֗ךָ לְמוֹעֵד֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב כִּי־ ב֖וֹ יָצָ֣אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹא־ יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ tiš·mōr šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā lə·mō·w·‘êḏ ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ kî- ḇōw yā·ṣā·ṯā mim·miṣ·rā·yim wə·lō- yê·rā·’ū p̄ā·nay rê·qām
verses.literal: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days because that was the month you came out of Egypt No one may appear before Me empty-handed

verses.original: וְחַ֤ג הַקָּצִיר֙ בִּכּוּרֵ֣י מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּזְרַ֖ע בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְחַ֤ג הָֽאָסִף֙ בְּצֵ֣את הַשָּׁנָ֔ה בְּאָסְפְּךָ֥ אֶֽת־ מַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥaḡ haq·qā·ṣîr bik·kū·rê ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ’ă·šer tiz·ra‘ baś·śā·ḏeh wə·ḥaḡ hā·’ā·sip̄ bə·ṣêṯ haš·šā·nāh bə·’ā·sə·pə·ḵā ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā min- haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year when you gather your produce from the field

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל־ זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י הָאָדֹ֥ן׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh yê·rā·’eh kāl- zə·ḵū·rə·ḵā ’el- pə·nê hā·’ā·ḏōn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Three times a year all your males are to appear before . . . the Lord GOD

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִזְבַּ֥ח עַל־ חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם־ זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יָלִ֥ין חֵֽלֶב־ חַגִּ֖י עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiz·baḥ ‘al- ḥā·mêṣ dam- ziḇ·ḥî wə·lō- yā·lîn ḥê·leḇ- ḥag·gî ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא־ תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ bik·kū·rê ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā tā·ḇî bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō- ṯə·ḇaš·šêl gə·ḏî ba·ḥă·lêḇ ’im·mōw
verses.literal: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ מַלְאָךְ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמָרְךָ֖ בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְלַהֲבִ֣יאֲךָ֔ אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲכִנֹֽתִי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·lê·aḥ mal·’āḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā liš·mā·rə·ḵā bad·dā·reḵ wə·la·hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer hă·ḵi·nō·ṯî
verses.literal: Behold I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר מִפָּנָ֛יו וּשְׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹל֖וֹ אַל־ תַּמֵּ֣ר בּ֑וֹ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ לְפִשְׁעֲכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁמִ֖י בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer mip·pā·nāw ū·šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lōw ’al- tam·mêr bōw kî lō yiś·śā lə·p̄iš·‘ă·ḵem kî šə·mî bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice do not defy him for he will not forgive rebellion since My Name is in him

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאָֽיַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ וְצַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ צֹרְרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- šā·mō·a‘ tiš·ma‘ bə·qō·lōw wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā kōl ’ă·šer ’ă·ḏab·bêr wə·’ā·yaḇ·tî ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·ṣar·tî ’eṯ- ṣō·rə·re·ḵā
verses.literal: But if you will listen carefully . . . to his voice and do everything I say I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יֵלֵ֣ךְ מַלְאָכִי֮ לְפָנֶיךָ֒ וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֗ אֶל־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וְהִכְחַדְתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yê·lêḵ mal·’ā·ḵî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā we·hĕ·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî wə·hiḵ·ḥaḏ·tîw
verses.literal: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites Hittites Perizzites Canaanites Hivites and Jebusites and I will annihilate them

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֤ה לֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א תָֽעָבְדֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י הָרֵס֙ תְּהָ֣רְסֵ֔ם וְשַׁבֵּ֥ר תְּשַׁבֵּ֖ר מַצֵּבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh lê·lō·hê·hem wə·lō ṯā·‘ā·ḇə·ḏêm wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh kə·ma·‘ă·śê·hem kî hā·rês tə·hā·rə·sêm wə·šab·bêr tə·šab·bêr maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them . . . or follow their practices Instead you are to demolish them . . . and smash their sacred stones to pieces . . .

verses.original: וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵרַ֥ךְ אֶֽת־ לַחְמְךָ֖ וְאֶת־ מֵימֶ֑יךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִ֥י מַחֲלָ֖ה מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’êṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ū·ḇê·raḵ ’eṯ- laḥ·mə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- mê·me·ḵā wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ma·ḥă·lāh miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: So you shall serve the LORD your God and He will bless your bread and your water And I will take away sickness from among you

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֛ה מְשַׁכֵּלָ֥ה וַעֲקָרָ֖ה בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ אֶת־ מִסְפַּ֥ר יָמֶ֖יךָ אֲמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯih·yeh mə·šak·kê·lāh wa·‘ă·qā·rāh bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā ’eṯ- mis·par yā·me·ḵā ’ă·mal·lê
verses.literal: No woman in your land . . . will miscarry or be barren I will fulfill the number of your days

verses.original: אֶת־ אֵֽימָתִי֙ אֲשַׁלַּ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהַמֹּתִי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖א בָּהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹיְבֶ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ עֹֽרֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’ê·mā·ṯî ’ă·šal·laḥ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ham·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer tā·ḇō bā·hem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ’ê·le·ḵā ‘ō·rep̄
verses.literal: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter I will make all your enemies turn and run . . .

verses.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י אֶת־ הַצִּרְעָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְגֵרְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־ הַחִוִּ֧י אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֖י מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣir·‘āh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḡê·rə·šāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥiw·wî ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥit·tî mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way

verses.original: לֹ֧א אֲגָרְשֶׁ֛נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת פֶּן־ תִּהְיֶ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְרַבָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’ă·ḡā·rə·šen·nū mip·pā·ne·ḵā bə·šā·nāh ’e·ḥāṯ pen- tih·yeh hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh wə·rab·bāh ‘ā·le·ḵā ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: I will not drive them out before you in a single year otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you

verses.original: מְעַ֥ט מְעַ֛ט אֲגָרְשֶׁ֖נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְרֶ֔ה וְנָחַלְתָּ֖ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ mə·‘aṭ ’ă·ḡā·rə·šen·nū mip·pā·ne·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ă·šer tip̄·reh wə·nā·ḥal·tā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you until you become fruitful and possess the land

verses.original: וְשַׁתִּ֣י אֶת־ גְּבֻלְךָ֗ מִיַּם־ סוּף֙ וְעַד־ יָ֣ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמִמִּדְבָּ֖ר עַד־ הַנָּהָ֑ר כִּ֣י׀ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיֶדְכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְגֵרַשְׁתָּ֖מוֹ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šat·tî ’eṯ- gə·ḇul·ḵā mî·yam- sūp̄ wə·‘aḏ- yām pə·liš·tîm ū·mim·miḏ·bār ‘aḏ- han·nā·hār kî ’et·tên bə·yeḏ·ḵem ’êṯ yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḡê·raš·tā·mōw mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines and from the desert to the Euphrates For I will deliver the inhabitants . . . into your hand and you will drive them out before you

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם וְלֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem wə·lê·lō·hê·hem bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods

verses.original: לֹ֤א יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְךָ֔ פֶּן־ יַחֲטִ֥יאוּ אֹתְךָ֖ לִ֑י כִּ֤י תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō yê·šə·ḇū bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵā pen- ya·ḥă·ṭî·’ū ’ō·ṯə·ḵā lî kî ṯa·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem kî- yih·yeh lə·ḵā lə·mō·w·qêš
verses.literal: They must not remain in your land lest they cause you to sin against Me For if you serve their gods it will surely be a snare to you
